recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered urban collage featuring high-contrast photography of men in a convertible car, set against a backdrop of concrete textures and architectural elements, utilizing a stark black, white, and muted yellow color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured stone header containing large-scale chiseled typography
Central photographic band with overlapping exposures of classic cars
High-contrast black foreground grounding the composition
Juxtaposition of rough masonry and sleek automotive surfaces
coreInvariants: Heavy stone-like texture in the top third
High-contrast black and white photography with a selective yellow tint

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subjects (men in a car) are positioned in the lower-middle third, scaled to fill the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured title at the top acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the heavy title at the top, down through the photographic collage, to the smaller subtitle in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space at the bottom provides a foundation for the lighter photographic elements above.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grey provide the structural foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light grey define the highlights and textured masonry.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: A muted, desaturated yellow/ochre tint is applied to the central photographic band.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, creating a gritty, monochromatic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to greyscale with one muted earth-tone accent

letterConstructionRules: Inner beveling to create a 3D stone-carved effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '+' symbol is integrated as a structural separator with the same texture as the letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, textured display type paired with a clean, light-weight condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the main title.
Matches the tall, thin profile of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-part horizontal layout. Top: rough grey stone texture. Middle: a collage of grainy, high-contrast black and white photos of men in a classic convertible car, with a subtle yellow wash and overlapping architectural elements. Bottom: solid black field with a thin white horizontal line separating it from the middle section.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, extra-condensed sans-serif text to the top stone section using a stone-carved texture and inner bevel. Add a light-weight condensed sans-serif subtitle in the bottom right corner, using white and a muted orange for specific words.

verificationChecks: Is the top text textured like stone?
Is the photographic section high-contrast and grainy?
Is the layout strictly divided into three horizontal bands?
Does the subtitle use a light-weight condensed font?

adjustableVariables: Amount of photographic overlap in the collage
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the heavy texture.
Verify the high-contrast 'noir' feel of the photography.
Check that the horizontal divisions are sharp and intentional.
Confirm the color palette remains muted and gritty.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Heavy Textured Display Type] + [Gritty Photo Collage] + [Solid Black Base] to create a [Genre-Specific Urban] aesthetic.
